property_summary: For any caller and any role, calling renounceRole(role, self) always succeeds without revert in the reference C, while the mutant reverses the check and reverts whenever account == msg.sender, so the fuzzer finds self-renouncement reverting in the buggy version.
change_summary: Flip the require condition to account != _msgSender(), allowing renounce only for a different account than the caller.
